question: Which of the following Articles mentions about a Uniform Civil Code throughout the territory of India?
solution:
__
 
• 
 
The correct answer is 'Article 44'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Article 44 of the Indian Constitution contains the provisions regarding Uniform Civil Code for the citizens.
 
• It lays down that "the State shall endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India&a
